Code.description: The license code, for some web api is case sensitive.

RequiresApproval.description: The flag allows marking a package with this license as AutomaticallyApproved.

RequiresThirdPartyNotices.description: The flag indicates that a package with this license should contain extra text in ThirdPartyNotices.txt

HRef.description: The link to the license content.

FileName.description: The name of the file in this folder, a copy of the license content, is used to generate third-party notices.

Dependencies.description: An array of license codes on which the license depends.
